::: {.page-intro}
<h3 style="margin-top:0;">week3_students.csv</h3>
<p><strong>Use this one for the in-class tasks.</strong> One row per student (24 rows): each student's mean reaction time, their corrected finger length, and a <code>finger_bin</code> column that splits the class into three roughly equal groups (Short / Medium / Long).</p>
<p>Used for computing the conditional mean by bin, building the finger length vs. reaction time scatterplot, and calculating the class covariance and correlation.</p>

::: {.page-intro}
<h3 style="margin-top:0;">week3_reaction_times.csv</h3>
<p>The full trial-level data (one row per trial): the same cleaned data as Week 2, plus two new columns. <code>finger_length_corrected</code> fixes the five finger lengths we agreed were wrong in the workshop (three entered in centimetres, two with an extra digit). <code>finger_bin</code> is the same Short / Medium / Long grouping as above.</p>
<p>Use <code>finger_length_corrected</code>, not <code>finger_mm</code>.</p>

::: {.page-intro}
<h3 style="margin-top:0;">wms_mexico_2013.csv</h3>
<p>The dataset behind the online session: the textbook's World Management Survey sample of 300 Mexican firms (2013, 100–5,000 employees), from Békés &amp; Kézdi, Chapter 4.</p>
<p>Columns: <code>management</code> (average of 18 practice scores, 1–5), <code>emp_firm</code> (number of employees), <code>lean1</code> (the lean-management practice score on its own, 1–5), <code>sic</code> (2-digit industry code) and <code>firmid</code>.</p>

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  document.querySelectorAll(".data-download-btn").forEach(function (btn) {
    var url = btn.getAttribute("data-url");
    var filename = btn.getAttribute("data-filename");
    var status = btn.parentElement.nextElementSibling;
    btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      status.textContent = "Downloading…";
      fetch(url)
        .then(function (resp) {
          if (!resp.ok) { throw new Error("HTTP " + resp.status); }
          return resp.blob();
        })
        .then(function (blob) {
          var objUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          var a = document.createElement("a");
          a.href = objUrl;
          a.download = filename;
          document.body.appendChild(a);
          a.click();
          a.remove();
          URL.revokeObjectURL(objUrl);
          status.textContent = "Downloaded — check your Downloads folder.";
        })
        .catch(function () {
          status.textContent = "Something went wrong — use the link below instead.";
        });
    });
  });
})();
</script>
```
